properties.name: Kabekona WMA
properties.special_rec_opportunities: A Great blue heron colony existed on the unit from 1975 to 1993. Mallards and blue-winged teal are now the major nesters on the unit.  You may see snipe, marsh wrens, muskrats and beavers in the wetlands and flush grouse in the aspen forest.

properties.name: Laura Lake WMA
properties.special_rec_opportunities: This unit offers wild rice harvest and wetland dependent wildlife viewing opportunities.

properties.name: Mud Goose WMA
properties.special_rec_opportunities: Hunter walking trails, wild rice harvesting, shore fishing at the Mud Lake dam and primitive camp sites.

properties.name: Mule Lake WMA
properties.special_rec_opportunities: Old natural stands of Red and White Pine.
